annotations.text: Final: direction B (Matchup) with E's up-next colouring - clay-tinted paper, clay-line border and hairline, No. in clay-deep. The before card sits beside it; the five directions are on the Directions page.

Queue tab, spectator app - the current card beside five directions. Same four queued games in each, one of them a bracket game (Battle for 3rd) so you can see how the chip sits.

A Numbered rail - big serif position number, names stacked; up-next card on clay-tinted paper. Most scannable order; tallest cards.
B Matchup - the Playing card's anatomy reused for the queue. Consistent tab to tab; only ~4 games fit a screen.
C Ledger - one card, hairline rows, up-next as an ink band. Densest and calmest; long names wrap and it reads less like cards.
D Name tiles - each player is a pill; players find their own name fastest, but the pairing reads weaker as a matchup.
E Up-next hero - one big card, the rest a compact list. Strongest hierarchy; games 2+ get small.
